How would we enable this in CI ? 
Why the Redfish mockup and the require the backend?
I propose that we focus on CI after we get the Cypress framework integrated in a manner that works for the project, in a follow-on MR - would require more investigation and conversations.

> Why the Redfish mockup and the require the backend?

We need to support both a mockup and backend API to offer a comprehensive testing strategy.

A simple Redfish mock example is added here in redfish-mock.json

We desire the ability to mock the API when working new features in parallel development and for mocking test cases to ensure test isolation and consistency - especially specific-scenario/bad values that are not available from a healthy live API.  The Intercept feature also lets you override responses in a live API.  So depending on your development need you can use mock, live, or a combo of both and tailor specific responses. This allows you to create a new test(s) for a bug and then submit the isolated test as a part of the fix - which should be a workflow goal.

We should be able to optionally run Component tests in the absence of a live API, for example in a repository git submit hook - in addition to unit tests.  This would lead to CI/CD stability around testing these areas.

Perhaps missing in the commit message is our end-goal for the types of webui tests for this project:

1. Unit Tests:  Jest --> Vitest (future: after we move to Vite)
2. Component Tests: Cypress E2E
3. E2E Tests: Selenium --> Cypress E2E

Following this merge we can discuss workflow improvements and CI/CD integration.

What I like about Cypress is that it has good support for both Vite and Vue, and can run in Vite without a complicated setup on the client.  So anyone that checks-out webui-vue can now run these tests in the browser without additional setup and software dependencies.

For what is this content used?

The redfish-mock.json fixture demonstrates how to mock Redfish API responses using Cypress cy.intercept(). This enables:

1. Testing without a live BMC backend
2. Testing edge cases and error scenarios that are hard to reproduce on real hardware
3. Isolated, repeatable tests independent of backend state

A usage example is added in the "mock Redfish API with fixture" test case.
